capability: Reconcile Hex UI with the single file-session accepted load receipt
searchEvidence: Independent review of frozen ec00930895facf0bbebe316681c962cd7abcf397 found a P1 F05 cross-layer race: RawBinaryEditorFileSession commits editor bytes/path before the UI continuation, but the workspace can suppress publication after late cancellation or a newer failed load. Separate adapter/VM ordering tests do not cover this interleave.

IRawBinaryEditorFileSession already owns accepted SourcePath; RawBinaryEditorFileResult is the existing immutable path/state result. Add one accepted-success receipt to that owner instead of another UI commit authority. Only production implementation is RawBinaryEditorFileSession; test implementations are ControlledFiles and DelayedSession.
semanticOwner: IRawBinaryEditorFileSession accepted-load contract; RawBinaryEditorFileSession atomically publishes the receipt with accepted editor load; Workspace consumes receipt identity and uses request generation only for failure feedback
terminalContract: Expose nullable immutable AcceptedLoad using the existing RawBinaryEditorFileResult. Publish a new receipt by identity only after a successful Load, together with bytes/path under the existing load gate. Failed/cancelled reads and SaveAs do not change the accepted receipt. UI reconciles any newly accepted receipt even when its await throws cancellation or the request is superseded; a stale historical result must never replay old state. Compare receipt identity, not equal values or path. Preserve precommit cancellation, latest-request adapter guards, non-destructive SaveAs, and existing UI picker lifetime guards. Add deterministic real-adapter/UI regressions for cancellation after commit, a later failed load before earlier UI publication, and delayed old completion after newer success; assert displayed path and exported bytes agree. Synchronize ADR 0014 and existing test doubles. No firmware/profile/CRC or release behavior changes.

designReview.evidence: 2026-09-25 bounded R2 design ADMITTED independently: existing atomic receipt owner is minimal; reconcile on cancellation/exception paths as well as normal completion, use object identity or monotonic commit identity, and do not change receipt on SaveAs/failure.
